command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r'); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; echo '=== package ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path moe.shizuku.privileged.api || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief moe.shizuku.privileged.api || true; echo '=== process ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -i shizuku || true; echo '=== external files ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'for d in /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api; do echo DIR=$d; ls -la $d 2>/dev/null || true; find $d -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 100 || true; done'
